reserves.name: DOLA deposited in the sDOLA savings wrapper

reserveReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
reserveReview.rationale: sDOLA is a receipt claim for one ERC-4626 asset: DOLA. The verified Ethereum implementation and official product guide identify DOLA as the deposited asset and describe immediate unwraps; no separate reserve basket or allocation is disclosed for the wrapper. The parent DOLA claim remains independently evaluated on its own record.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Verified Ethereum sDOLA ERC-4626 source and asset() read at block 25534205, plus Inverse sDOLA product disclosure.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unclassified wrapper-reserve exposure is present: the full wrapper reserve is the identified parent DOLA claim, whose own backing is evaluated on the DOLA record.
